title: StageRecord
description: One stage as the document stores it.

version.description: The version of the stage's contract: which schema its settings and output follow.

depends_on.description:
The hash of the input the stage read, so staleness can be worked out on load. Absent until
the stage has run.

settings.description: The settings the stage ran with (or will run with).

output.description: What the stage returned. Absent until the stage has run.

ReferenceLineIn.description: What the reference line stage reads.

river_polygon.description: The river as water, with its islands.

centreline.description: The river centreline the low-confidence stretches are counted on, when there is one.

low_confidence.description: The banks' low-confidence stretches (`low_confidence_width`), on the centreline.

parameters.description: The parameters the line is made with (the engine's own; recorded so a change shows).

Polyline.description: A line in the project CRS: `[x, y]` points in order.

RiverPolygon.description:
The river as water: an outer ring and the islands cut out of it. A ring is a [`Polyline`] that is
closed by implication (the last point joins the first).

holes.description: Islands: each is dry land inside the shell.

LineStretch.description: A stretch of a line by chainage, in metres, with its kind when it has one.

kind.description: What it is (`narrow`, `no-water`, ...), when it says.

ReferenceLine.description: What the reference line stage returns.

line.description: The line: a GeoJSON `LineString` in the project CRS. Chainage is along it from its start.

low_confidence.description: The banks' low-confidence stretches, carried onto the line by position.

outside_water.description: Stretches where the water is too narrow to hold the line.

notes.description: What the engine says about the line.
